$comment: Reviewed exemptions for the PLT-002 / PLT-006 command-fitness gate enforced by scripts/check-command-fitness.mjs. Every entry must name a verified reason, not a convenience. An entry without a reason fails the check, so a route cannot silently lose its idempotency requirement.

exemptions.reason: decideApproval takes the request row with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE and throws STALE_DATA when status is no longer PENDING, so a replayed decision cannot be applied a second time. SoD, expiry, delegation, and recent-MFA are all enforced server-side.
exemptions.limitation: A retry returns a domain error rather than replaying the original response. Acceptable for a decision that is final by definition.
